title: Rental as Percentage of Total Expenses of SMEs
what_it_is: Rental as Percentage of Total Expenses of SMEs

sections.label: SME property and rental costs
sections.summary: Property purchases count as fixed assets, not business costs, and rental costs form a small share of most SME business costs.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry))
sentences.text: In line with global norms, purchases of property are considered as additions to fixed assets and do not form part of business costs.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry))
sentences.text: As for rental costs, these generally make up a small share of total business costs for SMEs in Singapore.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry))
sentences.text: In 2016, rental costs contributed to between 0.4% and 5.3% of SMEs' business costs in the manufacturing sector and 8% or less of SMEs' business costs in most services sector.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry))
sentences.text: Although the rental cost share for SMEs in the retail sector was higher at around 30%, retail rents have been on a decline in recent years, falling by 16% from 2014 to 2017.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry))
sentences.text: Similarly, office rents have fallen by about 14% since peaking in 2015, while those for industrial land decreased by 13% since peaking in 2014.

sections.label: SME rental cost concerns
sections.summary: 13% of 2,500 SME respondents cited high rental costs as a top concern in 2017, down from 18% in 2015.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry))
sentences.text: On the back of the decline in rentals, only 13% of the 2,500 SME respondents in the 2017 SME Development Survey conducted by DP Information Group cited high rental costs as one of the top business concerns in 2017, representing a decrease from 18% in 2015.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry))
sentences.text: While the Government does not collect data on rental costs borne by SMEs and startups in other countries, property consultancy studies show that Singapore’s rents are generally competitive or comparable to similar cities in the United States, Switzerland and Japan.

sections.label: one-north take-up rate
sections.summary: The take-up rate in the one-north area is almost 90%.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: The take-up rate in one-north area is almost 90%.
